defect.locator_note: content/cases/Walder v. United States.md: frontmatter homes[0].page ('Fruits & Attenuation') vs '## Appears on' ('The Exclusionary Rule')
defect.problem: The frontmatter home is '[[Fruits & Attenuation]]' (Key — Anchor (impeachment exception)), but the page's own '## Appears on' section lists '[[The Exclusionary Rule]]'. The two disagree — an internal contradiction. Doctrinally, Walder is the origin of the impeachment exception to the exclusionary rule (built on Weeks, distinguishing Agnello); it is not a fruit-of-the-poisonous-tree / attenuation case, so 'Fruits & Attenuation' is the wrong home.
defect.proposed_fix: Reconcile the frontmatter home to '[[The Exclusionary Rule]]' to match the '## Appears on' section, the related cases (Weeks, Agnello, Havens, James), and the impeachment-exception framing.

reasons: The same content page names its home two different ways; sibling pages in this pack (Watson, Vernonia, Warden) all have matching homes/Appears-on, so this mismatch is anomalous and material.
The impeachment exception is an exclusionary-rule exception, not an attenuation/derivative-evidence doctrine, so the frontmatter home value is the misfiled side.
residual_risks: Without the taxonomy tree in the disclosed evidence, the exact canonical page name cannot be confirmed; but the internal home/Appears-on contradiction is disclosed and real.

reasons: Opinion at *65: 'It is one thing to say that the Government cannot make an affirmative use of evidence unlawfully obtained. It is quite another to say that the defendant can turn the illegal method ... to his own advantage, and provide himself with a shield against contradiction of his untruths' — verbatim support for the shield-not-license/impeachment holding.
Opinion: defendant 'went beyond a mere denial ... and made the sweeping claim that he had never dealt in or possessed any narcotics' opened the door; holding text is faithful.
Payload (good_law, migration-seed, as_of_treatment=2026-06-30, varies_by_point=false, scope_note re Harris/Havens extension and James cabining) matches the lake treatment block verbatim.
No confirmed negative treatment in the disclosed evidence; Walder remains the origin of the impeachment exception and is good law.
